sources.title: NeoGuard: AI-Powered Monitoring System for Preterm Infants in NICU

sources.title: SLM as Guardian: Pioneering AI Safety with Small Language Models
sources.snippet: In this paper, we leverage a smaller LLM for both harmful query detection and safeguard response generation. We introduce our safety requirements and the taxonomy of harmfulness categories, and then propose a multi-task learning mechanism fusing the two tasks into a single model.
